notes.subject: איעצה עליך עיני
notes.rationale: 'I will counsel you upon you my eye': 'counsel with my eye upon you' (JPS/ASV) vs YLT 'cause mine eye to take counsel concerning thee'; kept counsel + eye.

notes.subject: ⟨i kan⟩
notes.rationale: Bambara needs the locative 'on you' spelled out; Hebrew stacks preposition on pronoun.

notes.subject: kalanbaga / David
notes.rationale: Direct address — Yawe (or the psalmist) speaking to the one being taught.

notes.subject: ɲɛfɔ
notes.rationale: Offer of instruction and guidance addressed to the hearer.

translation: Ne bɛ i ɲɛfɔ ani k'i kalan sira min na i bɛ taa a la; ne bɛ i ɲɛmɛsɔrɔ, ne ka ɲɛ bɛ ⟨i kan⟩.
